name: Raising Up Leaders
overview: Scripture emphasizes the necessity of raising godly leaders who fear God, embody truth, and reject covetousness, as seen in Exodus 18:21 and Deuteronomy 1:13 where wise and understanding men are appointed as rulers. True promotion and leadership come from God alone, not from human origin or position, as Psalm 75:6 and Daniel 2:21 affirm God's sovereign hand in setting up leaders and granting wisdom. The Lord promises to provide shepherds who feed His people with knowledge and understanding (Jeremiah 3:15), highlighting the spiritual responsibility of leadership. Moreover, Jesus acknowledges the vast need for laborers in the harvest (Matthew 9:37), underscoring the ongoing call to raise and equip faithful servants for His work.
